title: DRC Ebola Cases Reach 896 With 232 Deaths Across 33 Health Zones
detail: As of 17 June 2026, DRC health authorities reported 896 confirmed Bundibugyo virus disease cases and 232 deaths (CFR ~26%) across 33 health zones — Ituri (21/36 health zones, 817 cases, 91.1% of the total), North Kivu (11/35 health zones), and South Kivu (1/34 health zones). A senior WHO official confirmed that 75 healthcare workers have contracted the virus since DRC authorities declared the outbreak on May 15, underscoring the toll on the response workforce.

media.caption: 'Rare, untreatable strain': Ebola toll mounts in eastern DR Congo

title: More Than 70 Health Workers Infected as DRC Ebola Outbreak Spreads Fast
detail: Al Jazeera reported on 19 June 2026 that more than 70 healthcare workers have been infected with Bundibugyo virus since the outbreak was declared, as the epidemic continues to spread quickly through eastern DRC's health zones. The high healthcare-worker toll is straining an already stretched response workforce across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces.

media.caption: Healthcare workers take measures against Ebola outbreak at a hospital in DRC
